about.title: About AssetNode
about.subtitle: We believe every organization deserves complete visibility into their IT assets — without the complexity of legacy tools.
about.storyText: AssetNode started as an internal tool to solve a real problem: tracking IT hardware across growing teams without the overhead of enterprise ITAM solutions. We're building the tool we always wanted — fast, clean, and honest about what it does.
about.basedIn: Based in Bonn, Germany. Built for the Mittelstand.
about.securityFirstDesc: Audit trails, role-based access, and data hosted in Germany. Privacy by design.
about.transparencyDesc: Every asset has a complete history. Every action is logged. No black boxes.
about.apiFirstDesc: REST API, webhook integrations, and automation-ready from the start.
about.multiLanguageDesc: Built with internationalization in mind. German and English out of the box.
about.bonnText: Our team works from Bonn, Germany. We're a small, focused team that ships fast and cares deeply about quality. We don't do "move fast and break things" — we move fast and fix things.

landing.heroSubtitle: Track hardware, peripherals, licenses, and consumables across your organization. From procurement to retirement — everything in one place.
landing.features: Everything You Need to Manage IT Assets
landing.featureLifecycleDesc: Track laptops, desktops, monitors, phones, and more from purchase to retirement. Manage statuses, warranties, and depreciation automatically.
landing.featureAssignmentsDesc: Assign assets to employees, build onboarding kits, and track returns. Employees can view their own items through a self-service portal.
landing.featureMaintenanceDesc: Schedule repairs and inspections, run self-audit workflows, and get alerts for expiring warranties before they lapse.
landing.featureLicensesDesc: Track software licenses with expiry alerts and manage consumable stock levels with low-stock notifications.
landing.featureLabelsDesc: Generate printable QR code label sheets for your assets. Scan to instantly pull up asset details and assignment history.
landing.featureReportsDesc: Export detailed reports, track total asset value, view category breakdowns, and monitor utilization across your fleet.
landing.benefitVisibilityDesc: See every asset's journey from procurement through assignment, maintenance, and eventual retirement or sale.
landing.benefitOnboardingDesc: Pre-built kits bundle hardware, peripherals, and licenses — assign everything in one click when new employees join.
landing.benefitSelfServiceDesc: Employees and managers can view their assigned items, request returns, and check on their team's assets without admin help.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Take Control of Your IT Assets?
